mechanism: ERC721 drop with a hard supply cap; safe mint calls onERC721Received
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'nextId', 'totalSupply']

ghost_state.name: pendingSupply
ghost_state.meaning: token minted before the hook whose supply increment is deferred

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for GenesisDrop_TH02a
  target property phi : totalSupply <= 3
  exposure site       : mint.onERC721Received  (receiver hook (via _checkReceiver))
  ghost state         : uint256 pendingSupply

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During mint's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['mint']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {totalSupply <= 3 && _status == 1} pre-phase {totalSupply + pendingSupply <= 3 && pendingSupply >= 1 && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = totalSupply + pendingSupply <= 3 && pendingSupply >= 1 && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_mint']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {totalSupply <= 3 && _status == 1 /\ pendingSupply==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => totalSupply <= 3
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['mint'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback mint preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
